topics.name: Virtual Memory & Paging
topics.description: Page tables, TLB, page faults, LRU replacement

questions.prompt: Which condition is NOT one of Coffman’s four necessary conditions for deadlock to occur?
questions.explanation: Deadlock requires NO preemption (resources cannot be forcibly reclaimed). If preemption is allowed, deadlock cannot occur.

questions.prompt: What hardware component accelerates virtual-to-physical address translation in modern CPUs?
questions.explanation: The TLB is a high-speed hardware cache of recent virtual-to-physical page translations.
